description: This file defines data transfer object (DTO) classes for coupons and related entities in an online shopping platform's frontend. These data classes are used for serializing/deserializing JSON payloads exchanged between the client and backend APIs related to coupon validation, application, removal, and associated data.

classes.name: CartLineItemDto
classes.description: Represents a cart line item with product ID, category, unit price, and quantity for coupon validation purposes.

classes.name: CouponRequestDto
classes.description: Represents the request payload for validating or applying a coupon, including optional email and item list.

classes.name: CouponRemoveRequestDto
classes.description: Represents the request payload for removing a coupon, primarily including email.

classes.name: CouponResultDto
classes.description: Encapsulates the normalized response detailing coupon validity, discount amount, messages, and rule metadata.

classes.name: CouponDto
classes.description: Provides coupon metadata such as code, description, discount type and amount, expiration, and minimum subtotal.

classes.name: CouponValidationResponseDto
classes.description: Models an older validation response, containing validity, message, and optional coupon info, maintained for backward compatibility.
